newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-FIFA TO RULE ON RONALDO MOVE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FIFA TO RULE ON RONALDO MOVE.

text.p: FIFA said on Monday it would decide if Brazilian striker Ronaldo was free to move from Barcelona to Internazionale.
Soccer's world governing body on Monday received an official request from Internazionale, along with 40 pages of documentation, supporting its claim to the world footballer of the year.

It will now be up to FIFA's players' status committee to decide whether the 20-year-old Brazilian is free to move to the Italian club after paying $27.6 million to free himself from his contract with Barcelona.

No date has been set for the next meeting of the committee but FIFA spokesman Andreas Herren said it was likely an extraordinary meeting would be called because of the interest in the dispute between the two clubs.
"The bottom line is that the Ronaldo case is now in FIFA hands," said Herren.
